query Query($where: WorkOrderProcessDistributionGroupWhereInput, $orderBy: [WorkOrderProcessDistributionGroupOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  workOrderProcessDistributionGroup(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        distributionUnloadPercent
        estimatedTime
        idealRate
        percentComplete
        producedQuantity
        productionOperators
        quotedRate
        requiredQuantity
        scrappedQuantity
        setupOperators
        setupRate
        standardRate
        allowDistributionUnload
        bottleneck
        locked
        requireParallelOutput
        singleSetupRate
        groupId
        actualFinishAt
        actualStartAt
        earliestStartAt
        latestStartAt
        scheduledFinishAt
        scheduledStartAt
        customData
        workOrderProcessDistributionStatusId
        workOrderProcessDistributionStatus {
          id
          name
          active
          completed
          hold
          new
          required
          started
          usable
          color
          description
          externalId
        }
        calendarEvent {
          id
          calendarId
          calendarEventTypeId
          title
          description
          priority
          eventJson
        }
        schedulingGroup {
          id
          name
          batch
          coProductType
          levelPositions
          levelWorkcenters
          nest
          productStrategyProcessType
          workcenterType
          componentProductStrategyProcessId
        }
        workcenter {
          id
          code
        
          hourlyLaborCost
          hourlyOverheadCost
          hourlySetupCost
          concurrency
          
          
        
          
          
          active
      
          description
          externalId
          name
          customData
          modeGroupId
          shiftGroupId
          calendarId
          facilityId
          locationId
          putAwayLocationId

          schedulingGroupId
  
          workcenterGroupId
          
        }
        distributions {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              number
              dispatchSequence
              balanceQuantity
              cycleTime
              estimatedTime
              fixedLaborUsage
              fixedMachineUsage
              fixedMaterialUsage
              idealRate
              laborUsage
              machineUsage
              materialUsage
              percentComplete
              producedQuantity
              productionOperators
              quotedRate
              requiredQuantity
              scrappedQuantity
              setupOperators
              setupRate
              standardRate
              bottleneck
              leadingProduct
              locked
              actualFinishAt
              actualStartAt
              earliestStartAt
              latestStartAt
              scheduledFinishAt
              scheduledStartAt
              customData
              workOrderProcessId
              workOrderProcess {
                id
                order
                quantity
                wip
                finishedGood
                externalId
                workOrderId
                workOrderProcessStatusId
                
                productStrategyProcessId
                workOrderProcessBoms {
                    edges{
                      node {
                        id
                        componentProductStrategyProcessId
                        componentProductStrategy {
                          code
                          id
                        
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                productStrategyProcess {
                  id
                  code
                  order
                  standardWorkcenters
                  cycleTime
                  distributionPercentage
                  idealRate
                  minimumProductionRunTime
                  percentToStart
                  productionOffalAllowed
                  productionOperators
                  quantityToStart
                  quotedRate
                  setupOffalAllowed
                  setupOperators
                  setupRate
                  standardRate
                  timeToStart
                  unitPerCycle
                  unitWeight
                  active
                  allowMixedLots
                  autoTriggerDependency
                  defaultDistribution
                  finishedGood
                  rawMaterial
                  
                  wip
                  description
                  externalId
                  processId
                  
                  productStrategy {
                    id
                    
                    primary
                    validated
                    externalId
                    name
                    
                    effectiveAt
                    expirationAt
                  
                    productId
                    productStrategyStageId
                    strategyTypeId
                    consumptionUnitId
                    inventoryUnitId
                    purchaseUnitId
                    saleUnitId
                    unitTypeId
                  }
                  productionTypeId
                  documentDesignId
                  lotControlId
                  putAwayLocationId
                  schedulingGroupId
                  screenId
                  workcenterId
                  assemblyBoms {
                    edges{
                      node {
                        id
                        componentProductStrategyProcessId
                        componentProductStrategy {
                          code
                          id
                        
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
              workOrderProcessDistributionStatusId
              assetId
              calendarEventId
              distributionGroupId
              leadingDistributionId
              workOrderId
              workcenterId
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
